lines.text: This is the Vanish mixer: the private way to move money on Solana.
Normally, every transfer leaves a public trail, straight from your wallet to whoever receives it.
First, connect your wallet and sign once to unlock your private balance. The signature never leaves your browser.
Pick an asset and one of the fixed sizes. Everyone deposits the same amounts, so every deposit looks identical.
Your browser builds a zero-knowledge proof, and your deposit becomes a private, encrypted note that only your key can spend.
Then give it time. The more people deposit after you, the bigger the crowd you hide in. The privacy meter shows exactly how big it is.
When you're ready, unshield any amount to any wallet. A fresh one is best.
Our relayer submits it and pays the gas, so your wallet never signs. Whatever you don't withdraw stays private as change.
Vanish mixer. Fixed amounts in, any amount out, and no trail between them. vanish.website
